newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli police arrest 12 Jews in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Israeli police arrest 12 Jews in Hebron.

text.p: Israeli security forces arrested 12 Jewish settlers who took over a house in the Arab casbah of the West Bank town of Hebron before dawn on Tuesday, Israel Radio said.
The radio gave no further details, but soldiers clashed with settlers last week after a similar pre-dawn takeover.
The settlers oppose an imminent deal with Yasser Arafat's Palestinian Authority to give self-rule to 80 percent of Hebron, a town holy to Jews and Moslems as the burial place of the biblical Abraham.

Arafat said earlier he hoped to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Tuesday to sign an accord on an Israeli troop withdrawal in Hebron, the last of seven West Bank towns due to be given self-rule under previous peace accords.

The settlers accuse Netanyahu, the right-wing Likud leader opposed to swapping occupied land for peace with the Arabs, of betraying them by sticking to the U.S.-backed Hebron deal signed by the Labour party he ousted in elections in May on a promise to providing better security for Israelis.
About 400 Jewish settlers, the Tomb of the Patriarchs and about 20,000 of Hebron's 100,000 Palestinians, including the casbah, will remain under Israeli control under the planned accord.
Officials say it could be implemented within a week of a deal being agreed.
